mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the 3-month Treasury yield (measured by GDPC1) over the next 60 trading days signals a flattening yield curve, which lowers discount rates and increases present value of future cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.05 over any 60-day window, or 20-day forward returns in flattening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation rate above 0.3% in a single month triggers a preemptive rate hike by the Federal Reserve, which compresses discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 20-day window, or 20-day forward returns in inflation spikes are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly PAYEMS employment growth above 0.5% for 3 consecutive months indicates a strengthening labor market, prompting higher equity risk premiums and compressing forward returns, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 20-day window, or 20-day forward returns in strengthening labor periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO supply growth acceleration above 0.8% signals excess capacity in the economy, reducing growth expectations and compressing discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.05 over any 60-day window, or 20-day forward returns in supply-side easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly HOUST retail sales decline exceeding 2% in a single month indicates weakening consumer demand, prompting rate hikes and discount rate increases that compress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 20-day window, or 20-day forward returns in demand shocks are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly FEDFUNDS interest rates over 3 consecutive months signals accommodative policy, lowering discount rates and increasing present value of future cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.05 over any 60-day window, or 20-day forward returns in fiscal easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE decline below 3.0% for 2 consecutive months indicates easing labor market pressures, prompting rate cuts and discount rate reductions that expand equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 20-day window, or 20-day forward returns in labor market easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
